title: Grade a Whole Answer Sheet
notes: Teacher only (401 signed out, 403 for students). Two steps. 1) POST /teacher/sheets/read with the questions on the exam (1 to 10 question ids, no repeats) and the scanned sheet (same page limits as contract 07). The model finds each question's answer on the sheet, by the numbers the student wrote or by topic, and transcribes it word for word; answers come back one per question, in the order asked. 2) The teacher checks and corrects the text, then POST /teacher/sheets grades each answer against its rubric exactly like a typed answer (two runs, verified quotes; the viva is not run). An empty text means no answer: every point is missing and it scores 0. marks = score/100 x max_marks, to the nearest half mark. GET /teacher/sheets lists graded sheets newest first; GET /teacher/sheets/:id returns one.
